title: Story premise ENT011: The Trophy Nobody Can Lift
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (two-person rivalry). Hook: Winning has become a lifting problem. Takeaway/theme: Competition can make the original purpose disappear.
description: Two rivals compete to decorate a shared trophy, adding heavier ornaments after every round. When neither can carry the result onto the podium, they remove one ornament at a time until only a simple cup remains, then argue playfully over who gets credit for the final subtraction.
